Ken (Platform): FYI sapphire sent INV-7510 for $27,300 dated 2026-04-01. Coupa marked it as duplicate and didn't route. Vendor lists PO SAPP-77. Can procurement advise?
Aisha - Procurement: SAPP-77 not in our current schema. @Sapphire Cloud Billing can you attach the invoice PDF and state onboarding contact?
Sapphire Cloud Billing: Link: https://sapphire.example/inv/INV-7510. PO field shows SAPP-77 (legacy). Onboarding notes reference Tara S. We can reissue with a new PO if you provide one.
Ben (Finance): Duplicate flag usually means the PO number already exists for another vendor. We need procurement to check mapping. Also need GL and cost center before considering provisional release.
Tara (SRE): This is for burst training capacity under PRJ-933. GL 5410. We used a temporary onboarding PO during the pilot.
POBot: Scanning PO namespace... Found SAPP-77 -> MATCH: PO_LEG_SAPP77 assigned to Sapphire on 2024-09-15. Also found a shadow mapping where SAPP-77 was temporarily assigned to another vendor during onboarding. Recommendation: procurement to consolidate and issue PO-2026-755.
Aisha - Procurement: I'll create PO-2026-755 and link legacy refs. Sapphire, please hold and reissue invoice with PO-2026-755.
Sapphire Cloud Billing: We'll reissue same-day. Question: invoice contains an "expedited setup" charge of $2,500; is that approved under pilot terms?
Tara (SRE): I approved setup as part of the onboarding ticket ONB-933-9. Uploaded approval to Coupa.
Ben (Finance): Given confirmation, propose provisional release up to $22,000 pending corrected invoice and PO link. Hold remainder until invoice/PO reconciled. Samir?
Samir (CFO): Approve provisional up to $22k for continuity. Finance to mark memo "provisional - legacy PO duplicate". Any dispute over expedited setup to be documented; we will honor if approval exists.
Sapphire Cloud Billing: Corrected invoice INV-7510-R uploaded with PO=PO-2026-755 and itemized lines.
POBot: PO-2026-755 created and linked to PO_LEG_SAPP77. Status: OPEN.
Ben (Finance): Received updated invoice. Queuing provisional payment per CFO signoff and holding $5,300 until final reconciliation.
Aisha - Procurement: Documenting mapping in PRQ-2026-210 and will update onboarding guide to avoid shadow PO reuse.
Ken (Platform): Thanks everyone. Closing the loop once the hold is released.
